_functions.name: writeHealthFraction
_functions.params: ByteWriter& out, double fraction, bool wide
_functions.body: const double clamped = clamp(fraction, 0.0, 1.0); if (wide) out.f32(static_cast<float>(1.0 - clamped)); else out.u16(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(clamped * 65535.0 + 0.5)); return quantizeHealthFraction
